messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Serbian (Latin script), guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Serbian (Latin script) line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.
takav me učinio je zver bez mira, koja, dolazeći mi na susret, malo po malo me je gurala nazad tamo gde sunce šuti.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑by‑Word Mapping Table (Serbian Latin)**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Word / Phrase | Back‑Translation (EN) | Status | |-------------|-----------------------|----------------------|-----------------------|--------| | tal | “such” – demonstrative adjective | takav | such | OK | | mi | 1st‑person pronoun, object | me | me | OK | | fece | causative verb “made” (remote past) | učinio je | made (compound past) | OK | | la | definite article (feminine) | — | — | **UNNECESSARY** (article omitted in Serbian) | | bestia | “beast” – creature lacking peace | zver | beast | OK | | sanza | preposition “without” | bez | without | OK | | pace | “repose / peace” (object of *sanza*) | mira | peace / repose (genitive) | OK | | che | relative pronoun “that” | koja | that (relative) | OK | | venendomi | gerund “coming on against me” | dolazeći mi | coming (to) me | OK | | ’ncontro | preposition “against” (direction of approach) | na susret | on encounter / to meet | **WRONG** (does not convey the adversarial “against” sense) | | a (1st) | part of idiom “a poco a poco” – incremental marker | — | — | **UNNECESSARY** (absorbed in “malo po malo”) | | poco (1st) | adverb “little” – degree marker | malo | little | OK | | a (2nd) | part of idiom “a poco a poco” – incremental marker | — | — | **UNNECESSARY** | | poco (2nd) | adverb “little” – degree marker | malo | little | OK | | mi (line 60) | 1st‑person pronoun, object | me | me | OK | | ripigneva | imperfect “was pushing back” | gurla | was pushing back | OK | | là | adverb of place “thither” | tamo | there / thither | OK | | dove | relative adverb “where” | gde | where | OK | | ’l | definite article (elided *il*) | — | — | **UNNECESSARY** | | sol | noun “Sun” | sunce | Sun | OK | | tace | verb “is silent” | šuti | is silent | OK |
---
### Items Requiring Attention
- **WRONG**: *’ncontro* → rendered as **na susret** (“to meet”), which loses the adversarial “against” nuance present in the source. A more faithful rendering would be **protiv** or **na suprotnu stranu**. - **UNNECESSARY**: Articles *la* and *’l* have no direct equivalents in Serbian and are therefore omitted. - **UNNECESSARY**: Both occurrences of the preposition *a* in the idiom *a poco a poco* are absorbed into the Serbian idiom **malo po malo** and do not appear separately.
All other source tokens are accounted for and correctly translated.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Serbian (Latin script) script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Serbian (Latin script) text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).
